editorsNote: Welcome, friends. This is our regular schedule. Every program is free of cost, and all seniors are welcome. Most programs meet on Google Meet: press the button beside a program to join. Bridge, karaoke and the Friday art and painting class meet in person at 31 Zukor Road, New City. Suggestions for current or new activities are always welcome. Call us, or speak to any coordinator.
